status_zh: 待情境審查，尚未關閉
description: Add 'defer tx.Rollback()' after checking the error from 's.db.BeginTx()' to ensure the transaction is rolle...
evidence: Store.BeginTx is a transaction factory: returned storeTx intentionally transfers ownership to caller, so deferring Rollback here would invalidate every returned transaction. Audited 30 production s.BeginTx sites: 26 direct deferred Rollback, 3 deferred closures calling Rollback, and tryBeginRulePublication rolls back on acquisition failure then transfers to beginRulePublication. Its four owners PublishRules/RepairLegacyMiddleware/InitializeRules/RestoreRulesV2Marker defer Rollback and explicitly commit. Ownership comment preserved; no suppression added.
review_reason_zh: BeginTx 工廠必須把活交易所有權交給呼叫端；在此 defer Rollback 會使回傳交易立即失效。已檢視 30 個正式呼叫點：26 處直接 defer rollback、3 處在 deferred closure 回滾，tryBeginRulePublication 在取得失敗時回滾、成功時交付 beginRulePublication；PublishRules／RepairLegacyMiddleware／InitializeRules／RestoreRulesV2Marker 四個最終擁有者均負責 rollback 與明確 commit。已有所有權註解，未壓制規則。
